selection.rule: For each of the six numeric publisher labels, rank all CSV-listed image member paths by SHA-256 of the domain tag metralign-carinthia-balanced-v1 followed by a NUL byte and the normalized UTF-8 member path. Select the first four paths, with member path as the tie break. Assign the four fixed crop positions in rank order. Selection uses no image pixels, prediction, score, coordinate, or result threshold.

claim_boundary.carinthia: Coordinates are exact only for deterministic crop-and-resize transformations within one already acquired SEM image. This is same-acquisition digital self-consistency, not independent reacquisition, native cross-magnification localization, or microscope-stage ground truth. Numeric defect labels are used only for balanced source selection, not as localization targets.
claim_boundary.digital_crop: Exact coordinates come only from deterministic crop-and-resize transformations of already acquired real SEM pixels. They are not microscope stage ground truth and do not represent independent captures.
claim_boundary.frozen_benchmark: This development track is separate from and cannot be pooled with the frozen synthetic reporting split.
claim_boundary.native_pair: Same-area native magnification pairs are compared to an independently computed feature-registration proxy. Proxy agreement is not physical ground truth or accuracy.

digital_crop_self_consistency.description: Five fixed positions in each 50k image; 0.1x crops are enlarged with Lanczos and localized back into the unchanged acquired image.
